    Settings & connection

    Off by default. Captures contain account session data and are not anonymized. You can review and send each ZIP yourself instead.

    Set up automatic return (optional)

    Select your character manually until this is configured. Menu images stay on this PC.

    On the character selection screen, select your character so Play is available. Then use the first button. After an expected disconnect, use the second button.

    Use your phone

    Use the same trusted home Wi-Fi. Run Allow-Phone-Access.ps1 once if Windows Firewall blocks the connection. It allows only this app on Private networks.

    Recorder details

      Activity:
      Connect uploads

      The optional Chrome connector connects to this PC without a PIN. It opens Azoth's upload page when you send a capture; sign in there if asked.

      1. In Chrome Extensions, enable Developer mode.
      2. Load unpacked: choose the browser-connector folder inside AzothCompanion.
      3. Open its icon to check the connection. After an update, use Reload in Chrome Extensions.

      Without the extension, download the prepared ZIP and send it on Azoth's upload page.

      What the checks mean

      The helper checks that the recording is readable and the ZIP contains exactly ledger.bin and steps.json. F8 labels describe your actions; they do not prove a particular packet occurred. Azoth supplies acceptance and new-packet results.

      Original recordings stay on this PC. The upload excludes raw HTTPS logs, key logs and screenshots. The ledger is not anonymized.

      Account and connection limits

      The collector runs without EAC. No account-safety guarantee is possible. Automatic return uses normal menus, stops on unexpected screens or account warnings, and attempts up to three returns within the recorder's 20-minute limit. You control gameplay and marks.

      Recorder guidance
      Unofficial community companion. Mission status and capture suggestions from Azoth Central.

      Correct only what you remember. Mark uncertain actions as unsure. Original timestamps are preserved.
